title: Global augmentation of source pieces
statement: For a finite-piece diagram D [lem-sc-compact-flat-finite-subcomplex-diagrams] and compatible maps p_n:L_n -> T, define the global map of a piece j using its augmentation at stage(j) followed by p_stage(j). At every later stage n this equals the augmentation at n followed by p_n.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Global augmentation of source pieces.

proof.text: Induct on n>=stage(j). The base is reflexivity. At the successor stage use D.compatibility and l_n;p_(n+1)=p_n. Naturality of the specified cocone then gives naturality of the global augmentation between any two pieces.

lean.statement:
theorem CompactFlatFiniteSubcomplexDiagrams.augmentationTo_eq
    (D : CompactFlatFiniteSubcomplexDiagrams Y L l)
    {T : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ}
    (p : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⟶ T) (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, l n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n)
    (j : D.index) (n : ℕ) (hn : D.stage j ≤ n) :
    D.augmentationTo p j = (D.augmentation n).app ⟨j, hn⟩ ≫ p n
